WAR PLAN REVIEW
Force-on-Force v0.1 - 0.1.2.2
conditional on the war starting
cues: Thirty-six thousand simulated wars.

FORCE-ON-FORCE
36,000 simulated wars
conditional on the war starting
Quickly, what this is.

WHAT IT IS
conventional · occupation
politics · economics
2,000 runs per scenario
We checked it against Iraq.

HISTORICAL CHECK
Iraq 2003: model ~157 / actual ~139
Iraq 2003-11: ~3,545 / ~3,500
(tuned to it: fit, not proof)
And the weak spots?

WEAKEST ASSUMPTIONS
1. govt accepts terms (judgment)
2. US support on day one
3. share who take up arms
4. economics  5. resistance ceiling
Full annexation. The whole country.

FULL ANNEXATION
conventional phase:
~27 DAYS (summer)
~36 DAYS (winter)
Slide two. Now the good news.

TROOPS TO HOLD CANADA
NEEDED: 490,000-710,000
SUSTAINABLE (no draft): ~370,000
Slide three. This is the one

WILL
~2% of Americans backed force
no pretext: US gives up 58-68%
crisis: Canada gives in 63-75%
The Arctic grab.

ARCTIC SEIZURE
US deaths: 5-10
still ends badly ~2/3 of runs
cheap to take, expensive to own
Alberta detachment.

ALBERTA DETACHMENT
US absorbs Alberta 15-20%
US gives up 42-48%
preserve forces: -55% Cdn deaths
Economic coercion. No invasion.

ECONOMIC COERCION
unresolved after 5 yrs: 60-66%
Canada GDP -14% (worst)
US GDP -1 to -2.4%
Slide four. No raids

RAIDS INTO ALASKA
no raids: US gives up 68%
SOF raids: 34%
Alaska Highway push: 25%
early-warning sites: 5%
It's all about the story.

THE MONTANA SHOCK
no incident: 72%
assassination: 8%
contested: 46%
lawful target: 66%
Ran it. The Americans give up zero

SEVEN GOVERNORS
US gives up: 0%
Canada gives in: 63%
WAR CRIME. WORST TESTED.
Slide five.

MOST US DEAD: ~6,700
COST: ~69,000 CANADIANS
Okay. The mobilization plan.

MOBILIZATION PLAN (400,000)
US deaths +25-45%
outcome +4-8 pts
Cdn deaths +20-30%
Size isn't the lever.

DESIGN > SIZE
US gives up +17-20 pts
Canada gives in: 25-32% -> 7-10%
Slide six. The money slide.

MAX-KILL: 4,100 US / 47,100 CDN
FABIAN:   3,660 US /  8,200 CDN
US leaves 86% (Fabian)
Slide seven.

MONTREAL IN DEPTH
low: 47%  high: 57%
fanatical: 83%
~47,100 Canadian dead
A winter start stretches

WINTER
27 -> 36 days
US deaths in phase +35%
~940 cold casualties
And what's not in the model?

NOT MODELLED
escalation · repression
provinces & Indigenous nations
US institutions · terrain
And what comes next?

ROADMAP
test harness (~1,000 variables)
cold weather · northern resources
oil · hydro · Rangers · narrative
0.1.2.1.1: ARCTIC WILDLIFE
Three decisions.

DECISIONS
1. fund the plan (incl. 50,000)
2. a government that never signs
3. discipline (no Montanas)
Then use a napkin.

DON'T SIGN
DON'T DIE
DON'T DO A MONTANA
BE EXPENSIVE

credits: Satire. Every character is invented. No real officials are portrayed; the Prime Minister is travelling.
All figures are medians and shares from Prime Rogue's Force-on-Force simulation (v0.1 to v0.1.2.2, November 2026), not any departmental assessment. Every result assumes the war has already started.
Brian, wherever you are, enjoy your retirement.
